scope: 33 resolved nonabstract Creature definitions from the pre-v302 catalog; original 20 chars retained. Four missing animal keys and two role-specific chars authored separately. No Core/Def/renderer/shared manifest edited by this generator.

integration.runtime: loadAtlas loads every registered sheet; MapRenderer.makeView selects chars[creatureSprite(w,c)] before animation/static/icon fallbacks. Same-key frames are also supplied for preload/static consumers.
integration.newGameSelection: createCreature picks char when present, otherwise sprite; its logic is unchanged.
integration.prototypeOrSpawnPolicy: No spawn, placement, AI, body, equipment, combat, or save rule changed. Kept excluded species are still drawn.
integration.marineCreatureDefs: No separate marine animal Creature exists in the 33-definition baseline. Coastal residents are humans with the existing worker/trader/healer/guard appearance aliases.
integration.otherLegacyAnimalConsumers: Repository source and resolved catalog searches found only the four authored animal sprite keys. No unrelated animal icon is used to stand in for these creatures.
integration.legacyHumanSpriteFields: player and reaver2 remain in inherited sprite fields but are not selected for new creatures when char is present. Existing raw hero/reaver0/reaver1 are the preserved save selections covered here; unknown historical save values are not asserted.
